evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moved directly from collecting basic move details into logistics probing without asking about concerns like on-time reliability or damage protection.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep confirmed Monday the 26th was available but never offered it as a Value Day or discussed whether other days might be cheaper. Quote was given for Monday without exploring date flexibility or savings.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never asked. Rep ended with 'I'll go ahead and send everything to you in an email' and 'just to make sure that everything will fit in one truck' — no ask for the business, no rate lock mention, no deposit policy disclosed.

top_strength: Joanna gathered logistics comprehensively — addresses, square footage, special items (workout equipment, TVs, monitors), packing preference, parking access, and fragile items — giving her solid material for the estimate.
coaching_note: Never ask for the concerns that drive the sale: replace the immediate logistics dive with the two-concerns question ('movers not showing up on time, or damage to items'), then deliver the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage while the customer still cares, before building the estimate.
